Hi @Haroenv ,

Our datas structure :
hit : { best\_offer : { merchant : {  name: "AAA" }  },   other\_offers :  \[  {  merchant : {  name: "BBB" }  },  ]}

I would like to use a refinementList to count all the hits per merchants (on best and others)
For example :

* AAA (1)
* BBB (1) <--- this one doesn't show up if we use only "best\_offer"

I could use only one attribute "best\_offer.merchant.name"  on refinementList.
I need both "best\_offer.merchant.name" and "other\_offers.merchant.name" and my structure can't be modified...
So i would like to create a custom widget but informations are a bit incomplet.

Thanks
